g.text: Vehicle Rental Management System - Use-Case Diagram
The database currently checks that the vehicle ID exists,
but does not check availability before marking it rented.
Admin functionality is a menu in main(), not an authenticated
admin account. Registration and all records are in-memory only.
The admin menu is read directly with cin in the source.
Discount percentage must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
Missing vehicle or invalid percentage produces no bill.
